{{Quote|We're sitting on top of the largest deposit of crystal yet discovered.|Colonel Baramak|<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Baramak''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] living during the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="SAB" /><ref name="DTS">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Defend the Shipment|Ilum}}</ref>

==Biography==
In [[3640 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|4}}</ref> he was stationed on the [[Imperial waystation]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] as part of the Empire's operation to acquire the [[adegan crystal]]s.<ref name="SAB" /><ref name="DTS" /> However, he learned that the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] planned on using their mining equipment to collapse a valuable set of tunnels, preventing the Empire from mining the crystals for months. Baramak decided to foil this plan by sending an Imperial-allied individual to destroy the Republic's mining equipment.<ref name="SAB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Colonel Baramak first appeared in the MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].

It is only accessible to Imperial players in the game on Ilum.
